one_liner: Spott builds an AI-native ATS and CRM for recruiting firms; its reported Series A makes it too late for HTGF’s pre-first-round outreach.

top_signals.signal: Reported funding totals €21.5 million: €3.2 million at seed in March 2025 and €18.3 million at Series A in September 2026.
Y Combinator lists Spott in its 2025–2026 European cohort.

Model score 84.7 of 100 (at the top of the reference cohort). Positive inputs include Bain experience, three known founders, a founder CTO, YC participation, a business-to-business product and a deep-tech classification.

team: Lander Degrève (co-founder and CEO) attended Bocconi University and previously worked at JPMorgan and Bain & Company. Manu Vanderveeren is co-founder and COO; Samuel Smeys is co-founder and CTO.
why_early: Whether either reported round was priced is unknown. The reported seed and Series A put Spott past the first-round outreach window despite the pre-Crunchbase badge.
devils_advocate_risks: The model’s technical-founder and top-university flags are not confirmed by the founder records.
Competition in HR tech and the need to localize for different markets are recorded risks.
next_step: HTGF Industrial Tech team: deprioritize for pre-first-round outreach. If speaking with the founders, ask whether the reported March 2025 seed was a priced equity round.
